lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: Which medical conditions qualify as a 'Communication Impediment' under Texas statutory standards?

options.text: Temporary seasonal head colds, sinus congestion, and acute mild sore throat
Autism Spectrum Disorder, Down syndrome, Asperger syndrome, PTSD, and mutism
Hypertension, high cholesterol, and minor musculoskeletal lower back aches
Mild near-sighted vision that is completely corrected by standard eyeglasses
